artworks.title: Mme. Kemp, 4th plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's head and upper shoulders. The individual is facing slightly to the left with their face in a side profile. The facial features include rounded eyes, a straight nose, and a closed mouth, surrounded by a few wrinkles. The person's hair is pulled back in a bun at the top of the head. They are wearing a high-collared garment with a visible band or clasp at the neckline. The background is plain with shading and cross-hatching for texture around the head.

artworks.title: Return of the Peasants (Le retour des paysans)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures engaged in work or movement. The scene is viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, with a high horizon below faintly sketched hills in the background. Delicate and detailed pencil strokes emphasize texture and create a sense of motion among the figures. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of grey. In the distance, there are rolling hills and vegetation, becoming lighter and less defined as they recede into the background.

artworks.title: Return from the Woods (Le retour du bois)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with detailed elements viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is visible near the top, featuring rooftops and a cloudy sky. Two figures are depicted, one crouching with a cloak and the other leaning on a walking stick. The background includes a rugged landscape with mounds, foliage, and rustic structures. The rooftops, shrubbery, and trees create layers leading back to the horizon. The etching technique is evident, with carefully etched lines defining forms and textures. The black and white palette enhances the details and creates a high contrast.

artworks.title: At the Foot of the Cross (Au pied de la croix)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling on the ground with hands clasped together in front of their face. The person is wearing a hooded garment and a long dress, with a stick on the ground next to them. In the background, there is a large stone or pedestal structure and a faint outline of a hilly landscape. The image has a sketch-like quality with a textured appearance.

artworks.title: The Manger (La creche)
artworks.medium: etching in green touched with green wash
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in profile, possibly full-length but partially obscured, situated towards the left side of the scene. The first figure is an elderly person, bent over and reaching forward with clasped hands. This person has pronounced facial features with a prominent nose, and their hair is completely covered by a headscarf. Their clothing consists of a long, flowing robe or cloak with substantial folds. The second figure, standing slightly behind and to the left, also has their hair covered by a cloth, and wears a similar long robe. This person's facial features are less distinct due to the angle but appear younger than the first figure. A small child is on the right side of the image, reclining in a crib filled with hay. The child is positioned with legs bent, arms slightly raised, and has a small, circular halo above their head. In the lower right foreground, a basket and a simple shepherd's crook are visible. The background is composed of a textured, cross-hatched pattern, possibly indicating a stone wall, and in the upper right, a simple light source emits rays, illuminating the scene.

artworks.title: The Manger (La creche)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: Two figures in profile are depicted from the waist up. The figure on the left is slightly behind, holding a lit candle. The person has distinct facial features and wears a head covering with visible patterns suggesting a textured fabric. The figure on the right appears slightly bowed and is also wearing a hooded garment that drapes over their head and shoulders, enveloping them in shadowed folds. The setting is dimly lit, possibly suggesting an enclosed space, with a background marked by cross-hatched lines creating a textured appearance. The interplay of light from the candle casts stark shadows, creating a dramatic scene.

artworks.title: Along the Top of the Hill (Sur le haut de la colline)
artworks.medium: etching retouched with crayon and ink
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a solitary figure leaning on a stick, looking towards the left. In the background, there is a low horizon with a sky dominating the composition. To the right, there is a rustic structure with a slanted roof, shrubbery, and a stylized tree. The artwork uses fine, detailed etching techniques with cross-hatched lines to depict texture and form. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones adding contrast.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Boy in a Tree (Paysage avec un garcon grimpe sur un arbre, dite "Le denicheur d'oiseaux")
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on light green paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a figure seated in a tree. The person is positioned with their back against the trunk, legs dangling down on either side of the branch, and head tilted downwards. It appears they are wearing a wide-brimmed hat. Their clothing is simple, possibly long-sleeved and loosely fitted. At the base of the tree, there is a staff or walking stick. The setting is a detailed natural landscape with dense foliage, other large trees, and a peaceful forest atmosphere.

artworks.title: Allegory of the Peasant and Fortune (Le paysan et la fortune: Sujet allegorique
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a simple house in the distance, trees partially obscuring it. The etching technique is evident with detailed lines creating texture. Three figures are present: a man with a walking stick, a seated woman holding a child, and an ethereal figure in the clouds. The man appears to look towards the ethereal figure. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of brown and beige. The etched lines vary in thickness and direction, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Allegory of the Peasant and Fortune (Le paysan et la fortune: Sujet allegorique
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with mythological figures integrated into a rural landscape. The image depicts a countryside path leading up to a pair of thatched cottages on a hillside, surrounded by trees and shrubbery. In the foreground, there are figures interacting with one another on the path. Above them in the sky, ethereal figures, including a female figure and a cherub, appear to be floating or emerging from the clouds, with the female figure extending a garland. The style of the illustration suggests fine and detailed line work focusing on both natural and mythical elements.

artworks.title: Top of the Hill (Le haut de la colline)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon line is situated just below the upper third of the image, showing distant hills or mountains. The style of the brushstrokes, or etching lines, is delicate and detailed, with varied line densities conveying texture and depth. A large tree trunk is on the right with branches and leaves. to the left are clusters of bushes and small trees leading to a small structure among the foliage. Groves and undulating fields stretch towards the horizon. The image is monochrome, with shades of soft grays to black, creating light and shadow variations.

artworks.title: Top of the Hill (Le haut de la colline)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is of a landscape viewed from an elevated point. A tree stands prominently to the right. The horizon line is high, delineating a distant skyline. The image features delicate etching or engraving lines for texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and sepia. Close to us, there is thick foliage leading towards undulating hills, trees, and a small structure or ruins in the distance.

artworks.title: Small Fountain, Child Playing on the Grotesques (Petite fontaine, enfant qui joue surdes masques)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This image shows a cherub sitting on a fountain head. The drawing depicts a scene where a cherub-like figure is seated on top of a sculpted head of an elderly man with a beard. Water is shown flowing out from the sculpted head's mouth. The lines are finely rendered with delicate hatching techniques to depict the texture of the beard and water. The cherub has a playful expression on its face. The background is subtly sketched, focusing on the central figures.

artworks.title: J. B. Poquelin de Molière
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile facing left within an oval frame. He has long, wavy dark hair, a prominent nose, and a slight mustache. He wears a dark coat, a high-collared lace shirt, and a red bow tie. The frame around the portrait is ornate, with decorative elements like flowers and scrolls. Below the oval frame, there is a scene of a man reaching towards a woman, set in a room with a child present. The background resembles a carved stone plaque with additional decorative elements.

artworks.title: F.M. Arouet de Voltaire
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the chest up. He is positioned slightly turned to his right, facing the viewer with a slight smile. The man has long, slightly wavy gray hair and is dressed in formal attire with a pink jacket, a white ruffled cravat, and a golden collar. He is surrounded by an ornate oval frame with laurel branches on either side. Below the portrait are three decorative panels with classical figures and inscriptions on scrolls. The background is a muted tan color with a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Bonaparte Premier Consul de la Republique Française
artworks.artist: Charles Francois Gabriel Levachez and Jean Duplessis-Bertaux after Louis-Léopold Boilly
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man in a red coat with a white high-necked shirt, and a scene below. The portrait depicts a man with short, dark hair, distinct facial features, and a firm expression, positioned slightly to the side. Below the portrait is an intricate illustration of a military review or parade outside a grand building with classical architecture, showcasing soldiers in formation, horsemen, and a watching crowd.

artworks.title: Bonaparte Reviewing the Consular Guard (La Revue du Quintidi)
artworks.artist: Charles Turner after John James Masquerier
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image shows a group of riders on horseback parading down a street. At the front is a figure on a white horse wearing a light blue coat and a bicorne hat. Beside them is a person in a dark blue coat with gold trim and a feathered hat. Other riders, including individuals in military attire and a person in a colorful ensemble with a turban, are also present. The horses are ornately dressed, and the background features a grand architectural structure with spectators in the windows. The sky is clear blue.

artworks.title: A Game of Cards
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and white heightening over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lewis Einstein
artworks.description: The image displays three people seated around a table. They are shown in side profile with detailed outlines of their faces and elaborate hairstyles. They are dressed in formal historical attire. A candlestick is on the table, illuminating the scene. The background features detailed interior decor. The drawing style is sketch-like with pen and ink giving it soft, monochromatic tones.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The scene features full-body depictions of multiple figures engaged in an event. Some figures are standing, crouched, or seated. Details of the figures' facial features and clothing are visible. The background includes rocky formations, a hill, and three crosses under a sky with clouds. An inscription on a stone block in the center reads "HVMANI GENERIS REDEMTO RI."

artworks.title: Ornament Panel: Nereid and Two Children Playing Musical Instruments
artworks.artist: Giovanni Pietro Birago and Zoan Andrea
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental design featuring various classical motifs and figures. The drawing is a vertical composition showcasing a richly detailed and symmetrical arrangement. At the top and bottom, cherubic figures are positioned. Some hold garlands or musical instruments. These figures are intertwined with elaborate foliage, scrolls, and a centrally placed urn with decorative elements like flowers and fruits. In the center, a ram's head is surrounded by swirling acanthus leaves. The design presents a harmonious fusion of human and natural forms in a classical style likely reminiscent of Renaissance ornamentation.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel: Griffins and Two Cupids Crossing Halberds
artworks.artist: Giovanni Pietro Birago and Zoan Andrea
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a vertical panel with classical decorative elements. The drawing includes symmetrical arrangements of foliage, urns, and winged mythological creatures. There are stylized motifs like a wheat sheaf, scrolls, acanthus leaves, a muscular torso armor, ornamental designs, cherubic figures with spears, additional urns, floral elements, and lion-like creatures with wings on an architectural base. The composition is monochromatic, highlighting the detailed line work and intricate design.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel: Nereid Ridden by Two Children
artworks.artist: Giovanni Pietro Birago and Zoan Andrea
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image displays an intricate assembly of flowing lines and symmetrical shapes, creating an elaborate vertical pattern. The abstract composition features ornate scrolls, symmetrically arranged forms, and detailed curves. The shapes evoke objects like vases, medallions, and carved figures. Faces, human-like figures, and animal shapes intertwine with decorative embellishments resembling a historical tapestry with classical ornamental motifs.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel: Three Children Blowing Horns
artworks.artist: Giovanni Pietro Birago and Zoan Andrea
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental design with various motifs arranged in a symmetrical pattern. The design includes intricate scrollwork, floral motifs, grotesque masks, and putti. In the central section, there is a vase-like form surrounded by scrollwork and floral decor. The artwork exemplifies the detailed and complex style typical of Renaissance ornamental designs.

artworks.title: Shepherd Dancing to the Sound of a Flute
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. W. Murray Crane
artworks.description: The image features multiple figures, both human and decorative elements. In the center, a full-length view of a person is standing with one leg forward and their arm resting behind their back. This person is dressed in period clothing, including puffy sleeves, breeches, and a wide-brimmed hat adorned with a feather. Their facial features are delicate, and their hair appears to be styled in an embellished manner typical of the era. To the right, another figure, seated, is wearing a simple outfit and is playing a wind instrument. Behind them stands a third figure with simplified features. This figure's hair is styled upwards, and they are partially obscured by the foliage. Surrounding these characters is a landscape with trees and grass. Above them are two cherubic faces on either side, seemingly floating amidst decorative swirls and floral garlands. Below the standing figure is a pastoral scene with a fourth character reclining, dressed in flowing robes. Additional decorative elements include a musical instrument resembling a bagpipe, vines, and geometric borders framing the scene. The background is mainly unembellished.
